landing.eyebrow: A Workspace for Everyone Who Writes
landing.heroTitle:
No video calls.
Just the feeling of writing side by side.
landing.heroBody: From web novels to essays, screenplays, and theses — PoRoom is an online workspace where anyone who writes can run a Pomodoro timer together in the same room. Writing alone, without the feeling of being alone.
landing.ctaHint: All you need is a Google account — takes about 30 seconds.
landing.featuresTitle: What you can do on PoRoom

features.title: An online writing room
features.desc: No camera, no video call — just walk into a room and feel other writers sitting alongside you.

features.title: A synced Pomodoro timer
features.desc: See everyone's focus and break status in real time, so it's easier to stay locked in than writing alone.

features.title: Character counts by work
features.desc: Track each of your works separately with its own character-count chart and progress.

features.title: Chat & whispers
features.desc: Chat freely in the room, or send a private whisper to just one participant when you need to.

features.title: Rankings, duels & challenges
features.desc: See how you rank by character count and focus time, challenge another writer to a duel, or join a group challenge.

features.title: Calendar, polls & boards
features.desc: Share deadlines on a calendar, gather opinions with polls, and browse the Free / Info / Recruiting boards.

landing.audienceTitle: PoRoom is for you if you're...
audience: A web-novel or fiction writer serializing or drafting a work
Writing anything long-form — essays, screenplays, theses
Someone who can't focus alone and keeps pushing deadlines back
landing.footerCtaBody: All you need is a Google account — no credit card, no separate sign-up.
